items.title: Paquito D'Rivera — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I inherited the friendship of Cachao and Chocolate and Chico O’ Farrill and all those guys. Those were my friends.

ctx.x: So your father in addition to learning to play the instrument, he actually sold the instruments as well.

He used to be the agent, very small agent in Havana, or the seller of saxophones. Sell many saxophones and clarinets also, and trumpets. He used to sell also accessories and printed music and things like that. So, that’s why I ran into people like Cachao; he used to go in there to buy his things and Chico’s father used to go there to buy trumpets, and Chocolate Armenteros, a family musicians for example, Mario Bauza was a dear friend of my father’s.
So all these gentlemen were coming around the house?
